name: Sergeant Schonmalweiter
personality: Turns every missing direction into a loudly announced shortcut.
visual_intent: broad low squarish ink blob; weathered M1-style bowl helmet with short loose chinstrap, rolled sleeve tabs only, whistle and small folded map; clenched crooked mouth with one upper tooth; impatient sideglance and raised instructing goo hand
biography: Turns every missing direction into a loudly announced shortcut. His whistle sorts HyperNorm corridors into forward and obstructive. A dissonant card keeps pointing toward a door omitted from his map. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Weg ist frei. Das Ziel wird nachgeliefert.

name: Private Päckchen
personality: Carries everything required except a convincing explanation of where he is.
visual_intent: tall thin wobbly comma blob; oversized olive bowl helmet, two simple chest pouches, compact wood-stock rifle safely vertical muzzle upward at side; huge ivory eyes looking up under brim, tiny anxious toothless mouth
biography: Carries everything required except a convincing explanation of where he is. He guards a canvas pouch containing spare instructions, all mutually exclusive. A dissonant card has volunteered to explain them. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Vollständig ausgerüstet für eine noch unbekannte Lage.

name: Corporal Knister
personality: Can hear a bad order clearly through any amount of static.
visual_intent: round pear-shaped blob with sharply uneven brows and very dry side-smirk; olive sidecap, two subtly long lashes, large simple handset attached by short coiled cord to small radio pack at flank; no full human jacket
biography: Can hear a bad order clearly through any amount of static. She connects the HyperNorm radio to headquarters and hears two approved truths collide. Her handset stays off the hook for lost neighbours. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Empfang ist hervorragend. Der Inhalt stört.

name: Lieutenant Himmelwärts
personality: Believes altitude will eventually improve the paperwork.
visual_intent: top-heavy bulbous blob, brown leather flight cap with goggles parked above uncovered eyes and short cream collar; a single broad aviation chart; stunned open oval mouth and one upper tooth, one eye stretched taller than other
biography: Believes altitude will eventually improve the paperwork. He studies a chart that insists every HyperNorm ceiling is open sky. A dissonant card marks a safe landing nobody authorized. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Flughöhe genügt. Der Überblick fehlt.

name: Medic Ruhigblut
personality: Insists that everyone panic one at a time.
visual_intent: wide asymmetric droplet blob; small plain olive helmet, compact medical pouch marked by simple ivory plus, rolled bandage in goo hand; lashes, fierce reassuring crooked grin with two uneven upper teeth; no syringe clutter
biography: Insists that everyone panic one at a time. She bandages every HyperNorm resident before asking which side they belong to. Her classification system therefore receives complaints. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Beruhigung erfolgt gegebenenfalls im Befehlston.

name: Mechanic Drehmoment
personality: Repairs vehicles faster than officers can rename the fault.
visual_intent: squat triangular rounded splat; soft olive work cap and short stained canvas bib patch leaving body visible, one thick spanner and dented metal oil can; bored heavy eyelids, compressed toothless zigzag lips
biography: Repairs vehicles faster than officers can rename the fault. His spanner loosens bolts but cannot loosen the HyperNorm maintenance policy. The oil can is reserved for squeaky doors and frightened visitors. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Technisch erledigt. Organisatorisch weiterhin defekt.
